run_TAPIR_forward_pass: run the TAPIR model forward pass to predict point tracks across video frames
estimate_TAPIR_trajectories: estimate trajectories for query points using cost volumes and PIPs refinement iterations
build_TAPIR_feature_grids: build feature grids from a video tensor using ResNet encoders at multiple resolutions
extract_TAPIR_query_features: extract query features from video and query points for downstream trajectory estimation
create_ParameterizedTAPIR_wrapper: create a ParameterizedTAPIR wrapper that injects Haiku parameters and state into TAPIR methods
